scope: Diagnostic intermediate/frozen comparisons only; final release acceptance remains a separate later run.
critical_cause: adw::ActionRow is a GtkListBoxRow; three sites appended it directly to GtkBox. gtk_list_box_row_grab_focus requires parent GtkListBox, verified by unchanged GLib assertion + backtrace and GTK4.22 source.
readonly_cause: A FlowBox with both single-page pagination buttons insensitive trapped real Tab before the source disclosure. Correcting ActionRow parents alone still reproduced it. Omitting useless single-page paging resolved it, verified with real Tab/Space and exact canonical source ID.
fix: Correct GtkListBox parenting; omit paging when one page and omit disabled paging controls otherwise; plain-text row titles/subtitles; normal native Button disclosure and Expanded state. No log suppression or custom Enter workaround.
diagnostic_method: No gdb/lldb available. Temporary LD_PRELOAD shim emits native backtrace then forwards original GLib assertion unchanged; G_DEBUG=fatal-criticals stops frozen failing run, passes intermediate fixed30-check run with empty application GTK logs. Shim is not installed in product.
